definitions.explanation: An informal meeting or assembly where people come together to discuss matters. Has a traditional, community-oriented nuance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{町内|ちょうない}→町内：13561_chounai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{寄合|よりあい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧。
⟦{村|むら}→村：02261_mura⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{寄合|よりあい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{祭|まつ}り→祭り：03735_matsuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{話|はな}し{合|あ}った→話し合う：02396_hanashiau⟧。
examples.english: We discussed the festival plans at the village meeting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{寄合|よりあい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{解決|かいけつ}していた→解決する：17191_kaiketsusuru⟧。
examples.english: In the old days, community issues were resolved through local gatherings.

notes:
USAGE:
A traditional term for community gatherings, especially in rural or neighborhood contexts. Also written as {寄|よ}り{合|あ}い. Historically, {寄合|よりあい} referred to councils of leading citizens during the Kamakura and Muromachi periods.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {寄合|よりあい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ (to attend a gathering)
- {寄合|よりあい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧ (to hold a meeting)
- ⟦{町内|ちょうない}→町内：13561_chounai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{寄合|よりあい} (neighborhood meeting)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{会合|かいごう}→会合：02605_kaigou⟧: meeting — a more formal and modern term for a gathering
- ⟦{集|あつ}まり→集まり：01689_atsumari⟧: gathering — a casual, general word for people getting together
